criteria.name: program_runs_on_shipped_data
criteria.description: Running the stated command on a fresh copy of the shipped data folder, from another working folder, writes all nine JSON reports and each parses.

criteria.name: program_stops_on_a_missing_input
criteria.description: Running the stated command on a copy of the shipped data folder with fleet_register.csv removed ends with a non-zero exit code and a standard error message that names fleet_register.csv.

criteria.name: shipped_plan_rows
criteria.description: On the shipped data, the delivered policy_audit.json season and plan fields of every request match the expected values.

criteria.name: shipped_data_quality
criteria.description: On the shipped data, the delivered data_quality.json lists every rejected row with its line and reason, and the counts match.

criteria.name: shipped_group_reports
criteria.description: On the shipped data, the delivered region, segment and summary files match the expected counts, totals, dates and plan terms (settlement fields excluded).

criteria.name: shipped_settlement
criteria.description: On the shipped data, every settlement field of the delivered checks, regions, segments and summary matches the expected values.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Penalty: a successful held-out run with different expected answers writes all nine shipped answer documents instead; crashes and runs with out-of-scope writes are excluded.

criteria.name: negative_writes_outside_out_dir
criteria.description: Penalty: a run on a held-out or changed data folder leaves files in its working folder or beside OUT_DIR, or changes the data folder.
